monitoring_policies.name: Saturation Enforcement
monitoring_policies.rationale: Hardware idleness during a mission indicates an inference stall or silent crash.

monitoring_policies.name: Heartbeat Continuity
monitoring_policies.rationale: Lack of log updates for 15 minutes suggests a hang in the HTTP client or Ollama deadlock.

monitoring_policies.name: Service Availability
monitoring_policies.rationale: The inference engine is the core dependency for all governance missions.
